name: cache-warm
description: Keeps the prompt cache of idle Claude Code sessions warm with activity-aware keep-alive pings. Configurable interval, on/off switch, idle cap, cost estimates, web dashboard.

enabled.title: Warm caches by default
enabled.description: Initial state of the master switch. Change it any time with /cache-warm:on and /cache-warm:off.

interval_minutes.title: Ping interval (minutes)
interval_minutes.description: "auto" picks 50 on a 1-hour cache and 4 on a 5-minute cache. Otherwise a number from 1 to 59.

max_idle_minutes.title: Stop after idle (minutes)
max_idle_minutes.description: Stop pinging a session once you have been away this long. 0 = never stop.
